title: Camion de reparto conducible con nitro y auto-flip (factory + spawner en el parking del HQ)
request: Otro tipo de vehiculo similar al Dusty Trip Car, construido con codigo propio (sin assets de terceros): camion de reparto 7x2.5x18 con caja de carga, traccion total (HingeConstraint Motor x4), direccion servo delantera, nitro por kickdown (mantener el acelerador a fondo 2.5 s -> boost de 3 s, recarga 6 s) con luces y particulas traseras, y auto-flip (AlignOrientation endereza el camion si queda volcado 2 s). Aparece en el parking del HQ (x=-67, z=-30), junto a los coches de cmd_000046, y se repone solo si lo borran o cae del mapa. Constantes tuneables arriba del modulo.

operations.source:
-- DeliveryTruckFactory v1 - camion de reparto con nitro y auto-flip, 100% codigo propio.
-- Hermano mayor del VehicleFactory (cmd_000046): mismo drivetrain (HingeConstraint
-- Motor x4 + direccion servo delantera) y dos sistemas inspirados en el Dusty Trip
-- Car analizado en cmd_000048: nitro (kickdown: mantener a fondo 2.5 s, boost 3 s,
-- recarga 6 s) y auto-flip (AlignOrientation endereza el camion si queda volcado).
-- Sin assets de la Toolbox: cero riesgo de scripts de terceros.

local DEFAULTS = {
	bodySize = Vector3.new(7, 2.5, 18),
	bodyColor = Color3.fromRGB(70, 74, 82),
	cabColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40), -- naranja de marca
	boxColor = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 240),
	wheelRadius = 1.9,
	wheelWidth = 1.4,
	axleZ = 6,
	rideHeight = 2.9,
	maxAngularVelocity = 21, -- ~40 studs/s con radio 1.9 (el coche hace ~50)
	nitroAngularVelocity = 34, -- ~64 studs/s durante el boost
	motorTorque = 90000, -- mas par que el coche: pensado para ir cargado
	motorAcceleration = 60,
	brakeTorque = 160000,
	maxSteerAngle = 26,
	steerSpeed = 5,
	driveSign = -1, -- si W va marcha atras, cambiar a 1
	steerSign = -1, -- si D gira al reves, cambiar a 1
	nitroHoldSeconds = 2.5, -- tiempo con el acelerador a fondo para armar el nitro
	nitroBoostSeconds = 3,
	nitroCooldownSeconds = 6,
	flipSeconds = 2, -- tiempo volcado antes de enderezarse solo
}

local TruckFactory = {}
TruckFactory.Defaults = DEFAULTS

local function newPart(props, parent)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	for key, value in pairs(props) do
		part[key] = value
	end
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function attach(parent, cf)
	local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.CFrame = cf
	a.Parent = parent
	return a
end

local function weld(a, b)
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0 = a
	w.Part1 = b
	w.Parent = a
	return w
end

local function sinColision(a, b)
	local n = Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")
	n.Part0 = a
	n.Part1 = b
	n.Parent = a
end

-- Create { name?, color?, cframe?, parent? } -> Model
function TruckFactory.Create(config)
	config = config or {}
	local cfg = setmetatable({}, { __index = DEFAULTS })
	for key, value in pairs(config) do
		cfg[key] = value
	end
	local origen = cfg.cframe or CFrame.new(0, cfg.rideHeight, 0)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = cfg.name or "DeliveryTruck"

	local chassis = newPart({
		Name = "Chassis",
		Size = cfg.bodySize,
		CFrame = origen,
		Color = cfg.color or cfg.bodyColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.8, 0.3, 0.2),
	}, model)
	model.PrimaryPart = chassis

	local cabina = newPart({
		Name = "Cab",
		Size = Vector3.new(6.6, 3, 4.5),
		CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(0, 2.75, -5.75), -- el frente es -Z local
		Color = cfg.cabColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.2, 0.3, 0.2),
	}, model)
	weld(chassis, cabina)

	local cristal = newPart({
		Name = "Windshield",
		Size = Vector3.new(6, 1.6, 0.3),
		CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(0, 3.4, -8.05),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52),
		Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
		CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.1, 0.3, 0.2),
	}, model)
	weld(chassis, cristal)

	local caja = newPart({
		Name = "CargoBox",
		Size = Vector3.new(6.8, 5.5, 9),
		CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(0, 4, 3.5),
		Color = cfg.boxColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.2),
	}, model)
	weld(chassis, caja)

	local parachoques = newPart({
		Name = "RearBumper",
		Size = Vector3.new(7, 0.8, 1),
		CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(0, 0.4, 9.2),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.2),
	}, model)
	weld(chassis, parachoques)

	for _, lado in ipairs({ -2.8, 2.8 }) do
		newPart({
			Name = lado < 0 and "ExhaustL" or "ExhaustR",
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Size = Vector3.new(3, 0.6, 0.6), -- el cilindro crece en X; rotado 90 queda vertical
			CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(lado, 4.5, -3.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52),
			Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
			CanCollide = false,
			CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.1, 0.3, 0.2),
		}, model)
		weld(chassis, model:GetChildren()[#model:GetChildren()])
	end

	local diametro = cfg.wheelRadius * 2
	local offsetX = cfg.bodySize.X / 2 + cfg.wheelWidth / 2
	local offsetY = cfg.wheelRadius - cfg.rideHeight
	local motores, servos = {}, {}

	local function crearRueda(nombre, lx, lz, esDireccion)
		local wheel = newPart({
			Name = nombre,
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Size = Vector3.new(cfg.wheelWidth, diametro, diametro),
			CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(lx, offsetY, lz),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34),
			Material = Enum.Material.Rubber,
			CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(1.2, 2, 0.2, 4, 1),
		}, model)
		sinColision(wheel, chassis)
		sinColision(wheel, cabina)
		sinColision(wheel, caja)

		local anclaje = chassis
		if esDireccion then
			local hub = newPart({
				Name = nombre .. "_Hub",
				Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6),
				CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(lx, offsetY, lz),
				Transparency = 1,
				CanCollide = false,
				CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.2),
			}, model)
			sinColision(hub, chassis)
			sinColision(hub, wheel)
			-- eje vertical: girar 90 grados en Z lleva el eje X del attachment a +Y
			local vertical = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			local servo = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
			servo.Name = nombre .. "_Steer"
			servo.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
			servo.ServoMaxTorque = 1000000
			servo.AngularSpeed = cfg.steerSpeed
			servo.LimitsEnabled = true
			servo.LowerAngle = -cfg.maxSteerAngle
			servo.UpperAngle = cfg.maxSteerAngle
			servo.TargetAngle = 0
			servo.Attachment0 = attach(chassis, CFrame.new(lx, offsetY, lz) * vertical)
			servo.Attachment1 = attach(hub, vertical)
			servo.Parent = chassis
			table.insert(servos, servo)
			anclaje = hub
		end

		local motor = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
		motor.Name = nombre .. "_Motor"
		motor.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Motor
		motor.MotorMaxTorque = cfg.motorTorque
		motor.MotorMaxAcceleration = cfg.motorAcceleration
		motor.AngularVelocity = 0
		motor.Attachment0 = attach(anclaje, anclaje == chassis and CFrame.new(lx, offsetY, lz) or CFrame.new())
		motor.Attachment1 = attach(wheel, CFrame.new())
		motor.Parent = chassis
		table.insert(motores, motor)
	end

	crearRueda("Wheel_FL", -offsetX, -cfg.axleZ, true)
	crearRueda("Wheel_FR", offsetX, -cfg.axleZ, true)
	crearRueda("Wheel_RL", -offsetX, cfg.axleZ, false)
	crearRueda("Wheel_RR", offsetX, cfg.axleZ, false)

	local seat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat")
	seat.Name = "DriverSeat"
	seat.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 1, 2.5)
	seat.CFrame = origen * CFrame.new(0, 2.4, -5.2)
	seat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52)
	seat.MaxSpeed = 0
	seat.Torque = 0
	seat.TurnSpeed = 0
	seat.HeadsUpDisplay = false
	seat.Parent = model
	weld(chassis, seat)

	-- Nitro: luz y particulas traseras (apagadas hasta el boost)
	local nitroFx = {}
	for _, lado in ipairs({ -2.5, 2.5 }) do
		local att = attach(chassis, CFrame.new(lado, 1, 9))
		local luz = Instance.new("PointLight")
		luz.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60)
		luz.Range = 12
		luz.Brightness = 3
		luz.Enabled = false
		luz.Parent = att
		local emisor = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emisor.Enabled = false
		emisor.Rate = 80
		emisor.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 10)
		emisor.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.4)
		emisor.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60))
		emisor.LightEmission = 1
		emisor.Parent = att
		table.insert(nitroFx, { luz = luz, emisor = emisor })
	end

	-- Auto-flip: AlignOrientation de un attachment, apagado hasta hacer falta
	local flipper = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	flipper.Name = "RedressOrientation"
	flipper.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	flipper.Attachment0 = attach(chassis, CFrame.new())
	flipper.MaxTorque = 500000
	flipper.Responsiveness = 15
	flipper.Enabled = false
	flipper.Parent = chassis

	local boosting = false

	local function velocidadObjetivo()
		return boosting and cfg.nitroAngularVelocity or cfg.maxAngularVelocity
	end

	local function aplicar()
		local throttle = seat.Throttle
		if throttle == 0 then
			for _, motor in ipairs(motores) do
				motor.AngularVelocity = 0
				motor.MotorMaxTorque = cfg.brakeTorque
			end
		else
			for _, motor in ipairs(motores) do
				motor.AngularVelocity = cfg.driveSign * throttle * velocidadObjetivo()
				motor.MotorMaxTorque = cfg.motorTorque
			end
		end
		local angulo = cfg.steerSign * seat.Steer * cfg.maxSteerAngle
		for _, servo in ipairs(servos) do
			servo.TargetAngle = angulo
		end
	end

	local function setBoost(on)
		boosting = on
		for _, fx in ipairs(nitroFx) do
			fx.luz.Enabled = on
			fx.emisor.Enabled = on
		end
		aplicar()
	end

	seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Throttle"):Connect(aplicar)
	seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Steer"):Connect(aplicar)
	seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
		if not seat.Occupant then
			setBoost(false)
			seat.Throttle = seat.Throttle -- reusa aplicar via señal no disparada; freno directo:
			for _, motor in ipairs(motores) do
				motor.AngularVelocity = 0
				motor.MotorMaxTorque = cfg.brakeTorque
			end
			for _, servo in ipairs(servos) do
				servo.TargetAngle = 0
			end
		end
	end)
	aplicar()

	-- Bucle de estado a 10 Hz: nitro por kickdown + auto-flip
	task.spawn(function()
		local holdTime, boostLeft, cooldownLeft, flippedTime = 0, 0, 0, 0
		local dt = 0.1
		while model.Parent do
			task.wait(dt)
			if cooldownLeft > 0 then
				cooldownLeft = math.max(0, cooldownLeft - dt)
			end
			if boosting then
				boostLeft -= dt
				if boostLeft <= 0 then
					setBoost(false)
					cooldownLeft = cfg.nitroCooldownSeconds
					holdTime = 0
				end
			elseif seat.Occupant and cooldownLeft <= 0 and math.abs(seat.Throttle) >= 1 then
				holdTime += dt
				if holdTime >= cfg.nitroHoldSeconds then
					holdTime = 0
					boostLeft = cfg.nitroBoostSeconds
					setBoost(true)
				end
			else
				holdTime = 0
			end
			local up = chassis.CFrame.UpVector.Y
			if up < 0.2 then
				flippedTime += dt
				if flippedTime >= cfg.flipSeconds and not flipper.Enabled then
					local _, yaw = chassis.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
					flipper.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
					flipper.Enabled = true
				end
			else
				flippedTime = 0
				if up > 0.9 and flipper.Enabled then
					flipper.Enabled = false
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	model.Parent = cfg.parent or workspace
	pcall(function()
		model:SetAttribute("_RBX_Vehicle", "DeliveryTruck_v1")
	end)
	return model
end

return TruckFactory

-- DeliveryTruckSpawner - coloca el camion de reparto en el parking del HQ
-- (memory/WORLD.md seccion 4) y lo repone si lo borran o cae del mapa.
-- El parking: coches en x=-84 y -76, camion en x=-67, todos en z=-30 mirando al sur.

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Factory = require(script.Parent.DeliveryTruckFactory)

local ALTURA = Factory.Defaults.rideHeight
local SPAWNS = {
	{ name = "DeliveryTruck_1", pos = Vector3.new(-67, ALTURA, -30), yaw = 180 },
}

local carpeta = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Vehicles")
if not carpeta then
	carpeta = Instance.new("Folder")
	carpeta.Name = "Vehicles"
	carpeta.Parent = Workspace
end

local function crear(spec)
	return Factory.Create({
		name = spec.name,
		parent = carpeta,
		cframe = CFrame.new(spec.pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spec.yaw), 0),
	})
end

for _, spec in ipairs(SPAWNS) do
	if not carpeta:FindFirstChild(spec.name) then
		crear(spec)
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(5)
		for _, spec in ipairs(SPAWNS) do
			local camion = carpeta:FindFirstChild(spec.name)
			if not camion then
				crear(spec)
			else
				local base = camion.PrimaryPart
				if base and base.Position.Y < -20 then
					camion:Destroy()
					crear(spec)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

print(("[Vehicles] %d camion(es) de reparto listos en el parking del HQ"):format(#SPAWNS))
